videos.title: Big Buck Bunny
videos.description: A large and lovable rabbit deals with three mischievous rodents in a peaceful forest landscape. An open-source classic created by the Blender Foundation.

videos.title: Elephant's Dream
videos.description: Proog and Emo explore a strange mechanical world inside a giant living clockwork structure in this pioneering open-source 3D animated short film.

videos.title: Tears of Steel
videos.description: Set in a dystopian future Amsterdam, a group of scientists and soldiers attempt to save the world from an invading horde of rogue robotics.
